settings.label: Ages 4–6
settings.title: Little Explorers
settings.text: Delicate skin that dries fast and messy hair days. This is where they learn to do it themselves.

settings.label: Ages 7–9
settings.title: Big Kids
settings.text: Active, sweaty and independent. They need cleansing that genuinely works after a full day outdoors.

settings.label: Ages 10–12
settings.title: Tweens
settings.text: Changing skin and oilier hair. They want products that feel grown-up — without harsh adult actives.
